replication.target_description: Direct replication certainty manipulation check: main effect of source certainty on perceived source certainty in the 2 × 2 ANOVA.

n.sample_role: Participants in the direct-replication 2 × 2 ANOVA subset; summed final mutually exclusive certainty groups.
n.exclusions: Primary analyses retained all participants in the direct-replication subset. Attention, comprehension, seriousness, purpose-guessing, speed and outlier exclusions applied only to separate robustness analyses (p. 7, §6.9). Extension conditions are excluded by §7.1 design.
n.quote: reported higher certainty in the high certainty condition (n = 257, M = ... 7.87, SD = 1.24) than in the low certainty condition (n = 253, M = 5.96,

es.quote: variable found support for the main effect of source certainty, F(1, 506) ... = 173.13, p < .001, ηp ... 2 = 0.25, 95% CI [0.19, 0.31].

p.quote: variable found support for the main effect of source certainty, F(1, 506) ... = 173.13, p < .001, ηp ... 2 = 0.25, 95% CI [0.19, 0.31].

notes: Identity verified in supplied canonical excerpt: title Uncertainty, expertise, and persuasion: A replication and extension of Karmarkar and Tormala (2010), authors Erik Løhre, Subramanya Prasad Chandrashekar, Lewend Mayiwar, Thorvald Hærem, JESP 113 (2024) 104619, DOI 10.1016/j.jesp.2024.104619 (p. 1, L0–L64). Published primary empirical Registered Report with actual Results, not a preregistration. Cache contains PDF-derived web excerpts (L0–371 and L488–896), not the complete 13-page paper. No local PDF supplied; no acquisition performed. Only assigned replication fields assessed. 257 high-certainty participants + 253 low-certainty participants = 510 participants. These are mutually exclusive final certainty groups within the direct-replication 2 × 2 model, not the whole-study recruitment N = 1018. No N was inferred from degrees of freedom. The target is the named certainty manipulation check, not source-certainty effects on the separate perceived-expertise manipulation check; that separate ANOVA reports F(1, 506) = 5.44, p = .020, ηp² = 0.01.
